annotations.title: Search the App Store and Google Play

description: Apps from the Apple App Store and Google Play by search words, app links or top charts: name, developer, rating, rating count, price, category, release and update dates, size, version, description and store link. Useful for app market research, ASO and competitor tracking. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/app-stores on your Apify account (about $0.0006 per app; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

apps.description: App Store or Google Play links, or Play package names, e.g. ["com.spotify.music"].

charts.description: App Store top charts in the country, with position.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

min_rating.description: Only apps rated at least this.

name: search_app_stores

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search the App Store and Google Play
